title: OC Register - News
content: The vibrant traditions of Orange County's Bengali community reached a wider audience as the Orange County Register recently featured the extensive preparations for Sanhoti’s Durga Puja festival. Highlighting the community’s dedication to cultural preservation, the article showcased local families in Rancho Santa Margarita coming together to rehearse traditional songs and hand-paint intricate decorations. Organizers emphasized that the festival, held in Costa Mesa, serves as a vital bridge between generations, fostering a deeper connection to Indian heritage for younger community members while inviting the broader public to experience the triumph of good over evil through music, art, and ritual.
